swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

steps.name: Run safe unit tests
steps.command:
swift test --enable-code-coverage -v \
  --skip SwiftMLTests \
  --skip SwiftClusterTests \
  --skip SwiftForecastTests \
  --skip SwiftExplainTests \
  --skip SwiftPreprocessingTests \
  --skip SwiftOptimizeTests \
  --skip SwiftLLMTests \
  --skip SwiftVisionTests

# GPU-dependent suites are skipped because GitHub macOS runners
# do not provide the Metal GPU environment required by MLX.
#
# SwiftPreprocessingTests:
#   SwiftPreprocessing links MLX directly and may crash at load time.
#
# SwiftOptimizeTests:
#   SwiftOptimize -> SwiftML -> SwiftPreprocessing -> MLX.
#
# SwiftLLMTests:
#   Tests create MLX arrays at runtime.
#
# SwiftVisionTests:
#   YOLOv8 / U-Net forward passes require MLX Metal GPU.

steps.name: Export coverage
steps.command:
BUILD_DIR=$(swift build --show-bin-path -c debug)
PROFDATA=".build/debug/codecov/default.profdata"

TEST_BINS=$(
  find "$BUILD_DIR" -name "*.xctest" -type d |
  while read -r d; do
    echo "$d/Contents/MacOS/$(basename "${d%.xctest}")"
  done |
  tr '\n' ' '
)

xcrun llvm-cov export \
  -format="lcov" \
  -instr-profile="$PROFDATA" \
  $TEST_BINS > "$SWIFTSCI_CI_OUTPUT/coverage.lcov" || true

steps.name: Build DocC documentation
steps.command:
swift package generate-documentation \
  --target SwiftDataFrame \
  --target SwiftStats \
  --target SwiftPreprocessing \
  --target SwiftML \
  --target SwiftCluster \
  --target SwiftNLP \
  --target SwiftOptimize \
  --target SwiftForecast \
  --target SwiftLLM \
  --target SwiftExplain \
  --target SwiftVisualization \
  --target SwiftVision \
  --target SwiftDatabase \
  --target SwiftAgent

steps.name: Verify documentation was generated
steps.command:
if [ ! -d "docs/data" ] && [ ! -d "docs/documentation" ]; then
  echo "❌ Documentation generation failed - no documentation output found."
  exit 1
fi

echo "✓ Documentation generated successfully."
